## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Added or updated tests (a failing test first for bug fixes)
- [ ] `pnpm smoke` / `pnpm test:integration` pass if runtime behavior changed
- [ ] Updated `docs/openapi.yaml`, `docs/SPEC.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` if the API changed
- [ ] No secrets or tokens in code, tests, docs or commits
